## Dentist - Checkup recall
**Sells:** Booked checkups

Finds patients whose last checkup was six or more months ago and who have nothing booked, and invites them back.

Run *Manual run* to execute on the built-in sample data. No credentials needed.

To go live: replace *Sample data* with the real source, *Draft message* with an LLM call, and the placeholder nodes with real send / approval steps.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(({json}) => ({json: {logged_at: new Date().toISOString(), automation: '06-dentist-checkup-recall', record_id: json.id, to: json.to || null, subject: json.subject, approval: json.approval, status: 'draft_ready'}}));
